title: Minnesota lawyer suspended over fake AI case citations

reading.body:
The incident title indicates that a lawyer in Minnesota was suspended in connection with submitting fake case citations attributed to AI-generated output. This is a known failure mode in which a generative AI system asserts fabricated legal citations as though they are real, and a user submits them in a legal proceeding without independently verifying their existence.

The failure occurs at the point of use rather than inside the AI system alone. A verification step, checking that cited cases exist in an authoritative legal database before filing, would have caught the problem before it reached a court or disciplinary body.

What is not established is the full account of what happened, which AI system was used, what the lawyer's specific conduct was, or what the precise grounds for suspension were, because the article body was not available to the reporters who summarized this incident.
